title: Agentic AI Empowered Intent-Based Networking for 6G
abstract: arXiv:2601.06640v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The transition towards sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks necessitates autonomous orchestration mechanisms capable of translating high-level operational intents into executable network configurations. Existing approaches to Intent-Based Networking (IBN) rely upon either rule-based systems that struggle with linguistic variation or end-to-end neural models that lack interpretability and fail to enforce operational constraints. This paper presents a hierarchical multi-agent framework where Large Language Model (LLM) based agents autonomously decompose natural language intents, consult domain-specific specialists, and synthesise technically feasible network slice configurations through iterative reasoning-acting (ReAct) cycles. translated_title: 面向6G的智能体AI赋能的基于意图的网络
translated_abstract: 向第六代（6G）无线网络的过渡需要能够将高层运营意图转化为可执行网络配置的自主编排机制。现有的基于意图的网络（IBN）方法要么依赖于难以应对语言多样性的基于规则的系统，要么依赖于缺乏可解释性且无法强制执行运营约束的端到端神经模型。本文提出了一种分层多智能体框架，其中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过迭代的推理-行动循环自主分解自然语言意图、咨询领域特定专家，并综合出技术上可行的网络切片配置。所提出的架构采用一个编排器智能体，通过ReAct式推理协调两个专家智能体，即无线接入网（RAN）智能体和核心网智能体，并以结构化网络（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的分层多智能体框架，通过编排器智能体以ReAct式推理协调无线接入网与核心网专家智能体，自主将自然语言意图转化为技术上可行且满足运营约束的6G网络切片配置，克服了传统规则系统与端到端神经模型的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical multi-agent framework where an LLM-based orchestrator agent coordinates RAN and Core Network specialist agents via iterative ReAct reasoning-acting cycles to autonomously translate natural language intents into technically feasible, constraint-compliant 6G network slice configurations, overcoming the limitations of rule-based systems and end-to-end neural models.
